name: Gate
description: A nonbasic land type for cards representing guarded entrances to cities or castles, introduced in the Return to Ravnica block.

timeline.summary: Gate is added as a new land subtype to the common dual-land cycle in Return to Ravnica so they could have a secondary mechanical purpose.
timeline.quote: The solution to this problem was to add a new land subtype, Gate, to the common dual land cycle.
